notes: The Hyperliquid adapter has complete support for user-specific liquidations via the userEvents WebSocket channel. The implementation includes proper data structures (WsLiquidationData, FillLiquidationData), subscription methods (subscribe_user_events), and event handling. No code changes are needed. The official Hyperliquid API does not provide a public liquidation stream - liquidations are only available through user-specific subscriptions. For market-wide liquidation tracking, third-party gRPC infrastructure would be required.
